name: comp-546
blurb: Grid layout for uploading and previewing multiple images.
description: Multi-image uploader with drag-and-drop support, displaying thumbnails in a grid layout. Each image can be individually removed.
use_when: Bulk photo uploads, gallery management, product image sets.
avoid_when: Single image uploads; use single-file variants instead.
a11y: Drop area keyboard accessible. Each image item has remove button with clear label.
